item.description:
Koegaki 1.5.0

  • New: Koegaki keeps its cleanup model current. When it starts, and once a day after that, it checks koegaki.com for a newer cleanup model and, when one is published, offers it on Home. Nothing downloads until you choose Update. The check fetches one small list of models; nothing about you or your dictations is sent.
  • After an update downloads, Koegaki asks you to restart, and the new model takes over on the next launch. If it fails to load, Koegaki goes back to the cleanup model it shipped with.
  • Home now offers Cleanup once, after your first dictations, so you can try it or leave it off. Off stays the default.
